title: Flat 13 has been sealed for twenty years
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark, moody, low key lighting, 35mm film grain, desaturated, realistic, rainy British city at night, no text, no watermark
hook_text: Every night at 2:14, someone knocked on my door.

scenes.narration: Every night at 2:14, someone knocked on my door.

shots.prompt: dim 1970s british council block corridor at night, one door, flickering light, no people

scenes.narration: Three slow knocks. Always three. I moved into Flat 12 last month. Cheap rent. The neighbours avoided the lift after midnight.

shots.prompt: british block of flats stairwell at night, grimy lift doors, fluorescent light

scenes.narration: Through the peephole stood a tall man. Black coat. Hands at his sides. Waiting. When I opened the door, the corridor was empty.

shots.prompt: view through a front door peephole of a corridor, blurred tall silhouette, fisheye

scenes.narration: The old woman next door whispered it. Flat 13 has been sealed for twenty years. The family just vanished. Nobody goes in.

shots.prompt: old brick british flats corridor, boarded door numbered thirteen, dark, no people

scenes.narration: That night my mobile buzzed. A photo. Me, from behind, standing in my own hallway. Taken a second ago.

shots.prompt: phone glowing in a dark flat hallway, blurred figure in doorway behind

scenes.narration: Three knocks. From inside the flat. I turned. The tall man stood at the end of my hallway. He looked at me, quite calmly.

shots.prompt: dark flat hallway, tall man in black coat standing at the far end in shadow, backlit, no face

scenes.narration: You're in my flat, he said. The door clicked behind me. I looked up. The brass number on it had changed. Twelve was now thirteen.

shots.prompt: brass door number thirteen on a dark front door, close up

scenes.narration: So tell me. Run for the door, or hide?

shots.prompt: dim 1970s british council block corridor at night, one door, flickering light, no people
